answer: What I'd try is grading every job twice, by two juries drawn from separate halves of the pool. Which half you land in comes from a hash of your address, so nobody gets to choose. The verdict only stands if both juries agree, and a split gets redrawn. Say a job checks comet sighting logs, the zenith times and brightness pulse readings. A farm holding a third of the pool can sometimes win one seven-seat jury, but winning both at once is far rarer, so it needs a lot more clones to swing anything.
